note: Detection is species-agnostic: combines a texture rule (5-feature GLCM/LBP, bucket-relative z-scores) OR a local-brightness rule (within-image relative, no external baseline). Rates measure whether the detector flags a region as anomalous, NOT species-level identification - that is Stage 3's job. Stage 2 must apply BOTH rules (texture OR local-brightness) to reproduce this detector exactly - using only the texture rule will not match these numbers.
